benefits.text:
With a unique design
Combines eyeshadow, lip color and blush in a single palette
Can be decorated with a keyring and strap

howToUse.text: Apply eye color evenly from the inner corner outward, lightly blend shimmer in the center of the eyelid for emphasis, then lightly line under the eyes to finish.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: A 3-in-1 eye – cheek – lip palette in chocolate rosy brown tones, helping create a sweet look that still has depth.

sellingPoints.text: 3-in-1 eye – cheek – lip palette; unique design inspired by the shape of a makeup palette; on-trend palette with multiple textures.

texture.text: Pressed powder in multiple textures; includes matte, shimmer and multi-use shades.

finish.text: Soft matte, light-catching shimmer, softly diffused color depending on the pan.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it can be used on all sensitive skin areas around the eyes/lips without dedicated testing. Do not claim long wear for lips/cheeks.
